Rare.name: Big Shield Gardna
Rare.desc: When a Spell Card is activated that targets this face-down card (and no other cards) (Quick Effect): Change this card to face-up Defense Position, and if you do, negate the activation. If this card is attacked, change it to Attack Position at the end of the Damage Step.

Rare.name: Enemy Controller
Rare.desc:
Activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.
● Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

Rare.name: Limiter Removal
Rare.desc: Double the ATK of all Machine monsters you currently control, until the end of this turn. During the End Phase of this turn, destroy those monsters.

Rare.name: Pot of Avarice
Rare.desc: Target 5 monsters in your GY; shuffle all 5 into the Deck, then draw 2 cards.

Rare.name: Reflect Bounder
Rare.desc: Before damage calculation, if this card is being attacked by an opponent's monster, and was in face-up Attack Position at the start of the Damage Step: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the attacking monster's ATK. If you do, after damage calculation: Destroy this card.

Rare.name: Solemn Judgment
Rare.desc: When a monster(s) would be Summoned, OR a Spell/Trap Card is activated: Pay half your LP; negate the Summon or activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

Super Rare.name: Book of Moon
Super Rare.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.

Super Rare.name: Metamorphosis
Super Rare.desc: Tribute 1 monster. Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with the same Level as the Tributed monster.

Super Rare.name: Night Assailant
Super Rare.desc:
FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.
When this card is sent from the hand to the Graveyard: Target 1 Flip Effect Monster in your Graveyard, except this card; return that target to the hand.

Super Rare.name: Sakuretsu Armor
Super Rare.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; destroy that target.

Common.name: Emissary of the Afterlife
Common.desc: When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Each player adds 1 Level 3 or lower Normal Monster from their Deck to their hand.

Common.name: Final Countdown
Common.desc: Pay 2000 Life Points. After 20 turns have passed (counting the turn you activate this card as the 1st turn), you win the Duel.

Common.name: King Tiger Wanghu
Common.desc: When a monster(s) with 1400 or less ATK is Normal Summoned or Special Summoned: Destroy those monsters with 1400 or less ATK. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

Common.name: Mudora
Common.desc: This card gains 200 ATK for each Fairy-Type monster in your Graveyard.

Common.name: My Body as a Shield
Common.desc: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or monster effect that would destroy a monster(s) on the field: Pay 1500 LP; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

Common.name: Mysterious Guard
Common.desc: FLIP: Target 1 face-up monster on the field, and if you control a face-up Warrior-Type monster, you can target 1 additional face-up monster on the field; return the first target to the top of the Deck, then return the additional target (if any) to the hand if you still control a face-up Warrior-Type monster.

Common.name: Stealth Bird
Common.desc: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

Common.name: Threatening Roar
Common.desc: Your opponent cannot declare an attack this turn.

Common.name: Thunder Kid
Common.desc: This monster stores electricity within his body, and can unleash it with catastrophic power.

Ultra Rare.name: Satellite Cannon
Ultra Rare.desc: This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a Level 7 or lower monster. During each of your End Phases: This card gains 1000 ATK. If this card attacks, this increased ATK returns to 0, after damage calculation.
